name: narrow-directional-controls
description: Native Up/Down controls at narrow desktop637x654 and phone740x360; measure actual safe viewport and44px touch targets with4px pair gap, ignore only effectively hidden NextWorld chrome, retain exact server direction and two-punch motion proof. Simulator restore is verified.

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local name="Smash Direction Desktop 637x654" local id
for _,candidate in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do local info=S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(candidate) if info.Name==name and info.IsCustom then id=candidate break end end
local config={Name=name,Width=637,Height=654,PixelDensity=96,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Desktop}
if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,config) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(config) end
S:SetDeviceAsync(id)
S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow)
local r=S:GetResolutionAsync() return H:JSONEncode({ok=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id and r.X==637 and r.Y==654,deviceId=id,width=r.X,height=r.Y})

local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local world=workspace.PunchWallRPG
assert(world:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio' and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false,'ephemeral Studio only')
assert(game.ServerStorage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true and p:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and p:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'ready unwritable profile required')
local a=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation assert(a:Invoke('Reset').ok==true) assert(a:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=250,WallLevel=99}).ok==true)
local root=p.Character.HumanoidRootPart root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-2,3,-27),Vector3.new(-2,3,-80))
return {ok=true}

local function awaitStableDirections()
 local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local h=g:WaitForChild('PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD')
 local previous,stableSince local deadline=os.clock()+5
 repeat
  local a,b=h:FindFirstChild('PunchUp'),h:FindFirstChild('PunchDown')
  if a and b and a.AbsoluteSize.X>=44 and b.AbsoluteSize.X>=44 then
   local key=tostring(a.AbsolutePosition)..tostring(a.AbsoluteSize)..tostring(b.AbsolutePosition)..tostring(b.AbsoluteSize)
   if key~=previous then previous=key stableSince=os.clock() end
   if os.clock()-stableSince>=.2 then return end
  else previous=nil stableSince=nil end
  task.wait(.05)
 until os.clock()>=deadline
 error('directional geometry did not settle within5seconds')
end
awaitStableDirections()
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local h=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD
local function effectivelyVisible(object)
 local current=object
 while current and current~=g do
  if current:IsA('GuiObject') and not current.Visible then return false end
  current=current.Parent
 end
 return current==g and g.Enabled
end
local function rect(object)
 if not object then return {exists=false} end
 local pos,size=object.AbsolutePosition,object.AbsoluteSize
 return {exists=true,x=pos.X,y=pos.Y,w=size.X,h=size.Y,active=object.Active,visible=object.Visible,effectiveVisible=effectivelyVisible(object),profile=object:GetAttribute('ResponsiveProfile')}
end
local function overlap(a,b)
 return a.exists and b.exists and a.x<b.x+b.w and a.x+a.w>b.x and a.y<b.y+b.h and a.y+a.h>b.y
end
local up=h:FindFirstChild('PunchUp') local down=h:FindFirstChild('PunchDown') local nextCard=h:FindFirstChild('NextWorldCard')
local a,b,n=rect(up),rect(down),rect(nextCard)
local count=g:GetAttribute('CharacterPunchCount') or 0
local upNext,downNext=overlap(a,n),overlap(b,n)
local upDown=overlap(a,b)
local ok=a.exists and b.exists and n.exists and a.active and b.active and a.effectiveVisible and b.effectiveVisible
 and not upDown and (not n.effectiveVisible or (not upNext and not downNext)) and count>=0
local result={ok=ok,count=count,upDirection=up and up:GetAttribute('PunchDirection'),downDirection=down and down:GetAttribute('PunchDirection'),
 up=a,down=b,next=n,upDownOverlap=upDown,rawUpNextOverlap=upNext,rawDownNextOverlap=downNext,
 visibleUpNextOverlap=n.effectiveVisible and upNext or false,visibleDownNextOverlap=n.effectiveVisible and downNext or false,
 camera={workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X,workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y},hud={h.AbsoluteSize.X,h.AbsoluteSize.Y},
 responsiveProfile=g:GetAttribute('ResponsiveProfile'),touch=game:GetService('UserInputService').TouchEnabled}
local function contained(r) local pos,size=h.AbsolutePosition,h.AbsoluteSize return r.x>=pos.X-.01 and r.y>=pos.Y-.01 and r.x+r.w<=pos.X+size.X+.01 and r.y+r.h<=pos.Y+size.Y+.01 end
local gap=a.exists and b.exists and math.max(b.x-(a.x+a.w),a.x-(b.x+b.w),b.y-(a.y+a.h),a.y-(b.y+b.h)) or -1
result.gap=gap
result.viewportValid=result.hud[1]>=612 and result.hud[1]<=638 and result.hud[2]>=606 and result.hud[2]<=655 and result.touch==false
result.touchSafe=a.exists and b.exists and math.min(a.w,a.h,b.w,b.h)>=43.999
result.contained=a.exists and b.exists and contained(a) and contained(b)
result.viewportValid=result.viewportValid and result.camera[1]>=240 and result.camera[2]>=200 and math.abs(result.camera[1]-result.hud[1])<=2 and math.abs(result.camera[2]-result.hud[2])<=2
result.ok=result.ok and result.viewportValid and result.touchSafe and result.contained and gap>=3.999
return H:JSONEncode(result)
